note: The 9 roles proposed in CR §8.1. Each is mapped to the actual governance convention rather than treated as a new organisational position. A single individual may fulfil multiple roles.

roles.primary_responsibility: maintains catalogue integrity, consistency and governance practices
roles.mapped_to: the programme owner (Emmanuel A. Otchere) for the DEA-PROCESS-ENRICH-000 programme; transitions to a designated catalogue steward on handover

roles.primary_responsibility: confirms the meaning, scope and operational accuracy of relevant Business Processes
roles.mapped_to: the originating process owner or accountable business authority; not yet assigned for the 146 L2 BPs (see ownership-register.json)

roles.primary_responsibility: reviews process models within an assigned domain
roles.mapped_to: domain-specific reviewers (F&A, P&R, P&V, S&D, R&C); not yet named for each L0 cell

roles.primary_responsibility: updates canonical entity information and documentation
roles.mapped_to: the cell-charter maintainers; canonical entity yaml is co-maintained with the EXT-08 documentation architecture

roles.primary_responsibility: ensures alignment with OpenDEA metamodel semantics and evolution
roles.mapped_to: the dea-metaframework steward; cross-repo coordination is via the dea-metaframework change control

roles.primary_responsibility: assesses evidence quality, provenance and verification
roles.mapped_to: the EXT-15 evidence framework owner; supports the deferred evidence backfills (REQ-19, REQ-20, REQ-21)

roles.primary_responsibility: maintains schemas, profiles, rules and validation tooling
roles.mapped_to: the EXT-23 conformance framework owner (the validator and the rule catalogue are the authoritative artefacts)
roles.scope: the conformance framework and the 52 registered gates

roles.primary_responsibility: maintains repository integrity, CI and contribution controls
roles.mapped_to: the repo maintainer; CI is governed by .github/workflows/ci.yml

roles.primary_responsibility: approves significant changes, exceptions and policy decisions
roles.mapped_to: the governance authority (Emmanuel A. Otchere); the EXT-23 exception lifecycle is the authoritative mechanism
